INSERT INTO [App].[ImportRun]
           ([PackageType]
           ,[PackageGuid]
           ,[CreatedDate]
           ,[Status]
           ,[ProcessingDir])
VALUES
           ('ChannelAsset_Execute'
           ,NEWID()
           ,GetDate()
           ,'Execute'
           ,CONVERT(varchar(255),@Folder))

SET @ImportRunId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

INSERT INTO [App].[ImportFile]
           ([ImportRunId]
           ,[FileName]
           ,[Status]
           ,[FileDate]
           ,[FileNameScheme]
           ,[Client]
           ,[Location]
           ,[Scheme])
     VALUES
           (@ImportRunId
           ,@FileName
           ,'Execute'
           ,GetDate()
           ,NULL
           ,NULL
           ,NULL
           ,NULL)


SET @ImportFileID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

SET @hasErrored = 1

UPDATE [App].[ImportRun]
SET Status = CAST('Invalid file name' + @file AS VARCHAR(50))
WHERE Id = @importRunId


UPDATE [App].[ImportFile]
SET Status =  CAST('Invalid file name' + @file AS VARCHAR(50))
WHERE Id = @importFileId

INSERT INTO [App].[ImportError]
           ([ImportRunId]
           ,[ImportFileId]
           ,[Message])
     VALUES (@importRunId, @importFileId, 'Outperformance file has invalid file name format.')

INSERT INTO [App].[Log]
           ([Process]
           ,[ExternalID]
           ,[LogType]
           ,[LogMessage]
           ,[LogTime]
           ,[LogNumber]
           ,[Source]
           ,[DetailedMessage]
           ,[LogLevel]
           ,[LogCode])
     VALUES
           ('Outperformance_Execute'
           ,@importRunId
           ,'Error'
           ,'Filename validation has failed'
           ,GetDate()
           ,0
           ,'Outperformance_Execute'
           ,'Failed to extract ' + @file + ''
           ,NULL
           ,NULL)

DECLARE @count INT

SET @hasErrored = 0

Select @count = Count(id) from App.ImportError WHERE ImportRunId = @importRunId

IF @count > 0  SET @hasErrored = 1

SET @hasErrored = 1

UPDATE [App].[ImportRun]
SET Status = 'Extract failed'
WHERE Id = @importRunId


UPDATE [App].[ImportFile]
SET Status =  'Extract failed'
